faqs.q: If a friendly Unit steals two d6s simultaneously, can I increase two Gigs?
faqs.a: Yes, the effect triggers for each stolen d6.

faqs.a: Yes. {Go Solo} plays Adam Smasher to the field area and triggers the {Play} effect.

faqs.q: If Adam Smasher is removed from the field area after being played to the field area is Adam Smasher removed from the game instead of being placed in the designated area?
If Adam Smasher's cost is reduced does that also reduce cost to activate {Go Solo}?
If I manage to play Adam Smasher on my Rival's turn. Does it still get the {Play} effect?
If my Rival controls exactly 2 more Gigs than me when I play Adrenline Converter but I steal a Gig before I attack with the equipped Unit, does it still have {Adrenaline}?

faqs.q: If I choose not to adjust a Gig, can I still draw 1 if I control 2 or more Gigs with different values?

faqs.a: No, the reduction amount is determined when you activate the effect.

faqs.q: When I play Appetite for Destruction, do I choose a friendly Unit, or can any friendly Unit satisfy the effect later this turn?

Do I have to defeat a rival Unit with cost 2 or less even if I don't want to?
If the second card my Rival discards also has a cost equal to a friendly Gig, does my rival have to discard again?
When I play this Program for less because of it's effect does that change the cost of the card too?
Does Chrome Fang's effect apply to all rival Units?

If my rival Unit has power 6 can it steal a friendly Gig with value 6?

faqs.a: The rival Unit gets the power boost for the ensuing fight and is defeated at the end of the turn.

faqs.q: If I have a Unit chosen by Evelyn Parker's second effect, do I have to attack with it as soon as possible, or can I play other cards first?
faqs.a: You may do other actions but cannot end your turn if the Unit chosen by Evelyn Parker can still legally declare an attack.

faqs.a: No. Johnny Silverhand still wins the fight, but Units at power 0 can't defeat other Units in a fight, so neither Unit is defeated.

faqs.a: Yes, but you still need to spend Johnny Silverhand to activate it.

faqs.a: The Player activating the card Chooses.

faqs.a: No, only the amount you pay.

faqs.a: No. To avoid invalidating Maxtac Squadron's effect, resolve it before any effects that would ready it.

faqs.a: Two Gigs with the same value within the same Gig area.
